Title: Enter results card on Home opens the Current Distributions page
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1688/Home.aspx as a signed-in external user.
Step Expected: The home page loads with the h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing.

Step Action: Look for the Enter results card under the Results section.
Step Expected: The Enter results card is visible.

Step Action: Click the Enter results card.
Step Expected: The browser navigates to the address path /DistributionsCurrent.aspx or /ResultsEntry.aspx.

Step Action: Read the main heading of the page that opened.
Step Expected: The h1 reads Current Distributions.

Step Action: Check the page for a server error message.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown.

Title: Current Distributions shows the empty-state message and no search form
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1688/DistributionsCurrent.aspx as a signed-in external user.
Step Expected: The page loads with the h1 Current Distributions and no server error page is shown.

Step Action: Read the message in the main content area.
Step Expected: The message reads There are no current distributions to display.

Step Action: Look for the labels Distribution Reference, Scheme Code and Scheme Name.
Step Expected: None of these search labels are shown.

Step Action: Look for the SEARCH and SHOW ALL buttons.
Step Expected: Neither button is shown.

Step Action: Reload the page.
Step Expected: The h1 is still Current Distributions and the message is still shown.

Title: View results card on Home opens the Previous Distributions page
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1688/Home.aspx as a signed-in external user.
Step Expected: The home page loads with the h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing.

Step Action: Look for the View results card under the Results section.
Step Expected: The View results card is visible.

Step Action: Click the View results card.
Step Expected: The browser navigates to the address path /DistributionsPrevious.aspx or /ResultsView.aspx.

Step Action: Read the main heading of the page that opened.
Step Expected: The h1 reads Previous Distributions.

Step Action: Check the page for a server error message.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown.

Title: Previous Distributions shows the search form and the empty-state message
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1688/DistributionsPrevious.aspx as a signed-in external user.
Step Expected: The page loads with the h1 Previous Distributions and no server error page is shown.

Step Action: Read the labels of the search form.
Step Expected: The labels Distribution Reference, Scheme Code and Scheme Name are shown.

Step Action: Look for the search buttons.
Step Expected: The SEARCH button and the SHOW ALL button are visible.

Step Action: Read the message below the search form.
Step Expected: The message reads There are no distributions to display.

Step Action: Reload the page.
Step Expected: The h1 is still Previous Distributions and the search form is still shown.

Title: Searching Previous Distributions with an unknown reference keeps the empty result
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1688/DistributionsPrevious.aspx as a signed-in external user.
Step Expected: The page loads with the h1 Previous Distributions.

Step Action: Type ZZ-NO-SUCH-REF in the Distribution Reference box.
Step Expected: The box shows ZZ-NO-SUCH-REF.

Step Action: Click the SEARCH button.
Step Expected: The page reloads with the h1 Previous Distributions and no server error page is shown.

Step Action: Read the message below the search form.
Step Expected: The message reads There are no distributions to display.

Step Action: Click the SHOW ALL button.
Step Expected: The page reloads with the h1 Previous Distributions and the search form is still shown.

Step Action: Read the Distribution Reference box and the message.
Step Expected: The Distribution Reference box is cleared or empty and the message reads There are no distributions to display.
